entry.title: reMixXXL CUE 0.1.3
entry.summary: ## reMixXXL 0.1.25: cue (PFL) for beat matching Tested by the author on an Akai Force (MPC OS 3.9.1). **What's new** - **Cue (PFL) on its own outputs.** Outputs **1/2 are the main mix**. A deck with PFL on is taken out of the main mix and is heard **only on outputs 3/4, which you listen to on the headphones jack**: **decks 1 and 3 on the left, decks 2 and 4 on the right**, so you can beat match. - **The cue is pre-fader.** A deck with its channel fader all the way down is still heard in the cue.
